title: Punctured-neighborhood cohomology diagram and canonical restriction cocone
statement: Let $T$ be a topological space, $Z\subseteq T$ closed, and $A$ an abelian sheaf. Put $S=\{t\in T:(\overline{\{t\}}\cap Z)\ne\varnothing,\ t\notin Z\}$ with its subspace topology. Let $I$ be the set of quasi-compact open subsets $N\subseteq T$ containing $Z$, ordered by inclusion. For each $p\in\mathbb N$, define a diagram $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Ab}$ by $D(N)=H^p(N\setminus Z,A|_{N\setminus Z})$, using the object-cohomology presheaf [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], and ordinary restriction transitions. Define its restriction cocone with vertex $H^p(S,A|_S)$: use inverse image along $S\hookrightarrow T$ [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image], the canonical cohomology pullback [def-weil-pbc-topological-object-cohomology-pullback], and restriction from the inverse image of $N\setminus Z$ to all of $S$. This inverse image is all of $S$, since an open containing a specialization contains its generalizations. The cocone uses the notion of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].
